results.content:
Based on 79 reviews

Review LinkedIn?

Reviewers mostly see LinkedIn as the default place for professional networking, job discovery, hiring, research, and building a public work profile. Many say it works best when used actively through posting, commenting, and outreach, and several mention strong search, filters, and direct access to recruiters, founders, clients, and decision-makers. Founder feedback is especially positive: the makers of Extrovert call it the best place to build sales relationships, while others say it helped them find early users. The main complaints are a cluttered feed, spammy messages, fake or ghost listings, and too much low-quality, AI-generated or influencer-style content.

results.title: Careerflow LinkedIn Optimization Tool Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
Review Careerflow LinkedIn Optimization Tool?

Reviewers say Careerflow is most useful as a browser-based job search organizer with practical LinkedIn guidance. Users repeatedly praise the Chrome extension, live profile feedback, step-by-step advice for headlines, summaries, and experience, and the way it keeps resumes, applications, and job posts in one place to save time. The main complaints are familiar: AI suggestions can feel generic or need human edits, resume design and customization are limited, and some premium or billing flows are confusing. One negative review also questioned accuracy and value.

Review Taplio?

Reviewers see Taplio as a solid LinkedIn-focused tool that makes posting, scheduling, and engagement easier, with some saying it saves real time and works better than using LinkedIn alone. Its focus on one platform is a plus for people who want dedicated LinkedIn workflows. But the praise is tempered by repeated concerns about price, with several users saying the value feels weak. Common complaints include uneven AI output, slow loading or search, clunky team use, limited weekend support, and credit use that feels poorly allocated.
